item.title: Secnotes HTB Writeup
item.description: SecNotes is a medium difficulty machine, which highlights the risks associated with weak password change mechanisms, lack of CSRF protection and insufficient validation of user input. It also teaches about Windows Subsystem for Linux enumeration.

item.title: TwoDotsHorror HTB Writeup
item.description: Everything starts from a dot and builds up to two. Uniting them is like a kiss in the dark from a stranger. Made up horrors to help you cope with the real ones, join us to take a bite at the two-sentence horror stories on our very own TwoDots Horror™ blog.
